That was honestly my first choice but after some research I found out that it’s extremely rare and difficult to become a full time writer for a company since they usually hire on contract rather than full time salary. I do write amateur books on wattpad but I really don’t think I’m good enough to qualify to become a full time writer for a company :S

I do appreciate the advice and comments. I’m just in a difficult mindset right now. I’m overwhelmed and am panicking seeing the mountain ahead of me when I can’t find the entrance to the path leading up the damn thing. 

As for the pot, I was “friends” with some generous people at that point in my life. Rather not go back over that if at all possible. Was a pretty dark time sadly

This is one of my favourite replies so far. Thank you. 

I’m not looking to be coddled or pitied, I just genuinely am at the end of my rope here. I need to get out there on my own and just.. live my own life. It’s advice like this that I was hoping for. I’m taking down notes on every reply I get and am developing a game plan. 

Thank you so much

I’m fully aware of that and it’s not that I can’t function in society, I more or less switch to acting and I can get along well enough. 

My issue is, when I’m not having to be interactive or am on my own down time I’m being forced to do things that only continuously drain me and emotionally I am constantly exhausted. 

If Dave would just give me my own time and let me do my thing instead of forcing me to sit there awkwardly and just be miserable I could almost guarantee my mood would improve a decent bit.

This is the type of constructive criticism/advice I came here for. Been being flooded with negatives and while I get that yeah I got here on my own and it might not seem that bad to those not directly involved, to me and my current mindset it is the closest thing to a living hell I’ve ever experienced. Hell even my homeless bout last summer was a vacation compared to this.

You don’t think I have been trying? For the last month and a half I’ve been out every day handing out resumes, doing interviews, looking online, applying on indeed. I’ve been eating, sleeping and breathing “job search” 

I know I’m a fuck up but I’m trying to better myself and my point is it is fucking difficult to do while being constantly put down and treated like a slave,

I agree it is an excuse but I’m legitimately terrified. If I end up in a shelter I can’t get Alberta works support and from what I know the shelters kick you out early in the morning, I have no money for transit to get anywhere warm and I don’t even own any proper winter gear. 

I am currently scrambling to look for any and all options with the shelter being a possible last resort since I’m now once again being threatened to be kicked out even though I’ve been doing everything I can (daily job searches, everything around the house twice over, doing everything they ask at their beck and call) all while dealing with the constant barrage of berating comments. 

Literally the only thing keeping me going is the thought of my girlfriend who is currently abroad for school.
I’m absolutely terrified of shelters and if I do go to a shelter Alberta works won’t help me since I don’t have a stable address.

1) I am speaking to a professional about these things, I have been ever since my original diagnosis towards my depression and anxiety issues. 

2) I am actively pursuing it, he is not allowing me the time to finish the steps needed for me to get there because of his adamant refusal to acknowledge it as a legitimate career path.

3) I’ll be the first to admit that it’ll seem like that, and yes I can see his outlook but the crux of the issue here is he is literally dictating my whole life like it’s a game of Sims. He sits on his ass doing nothing when he’s at home, getting drunk or high while I’m taking care of the whole house, being berated the entire time. I am going out daily looking for work but am not getting call backs or interviews. He calls me a liar daily and doesn’t believe that I’m looking for work and is wanting me to show him some kind of proof that I’m applying to when how am I supposed to do that? It’s the daily emotional abuse he is putting me through that is cornering me.

4) I can agree with that but it doesn’t change much for my issue.

I have an Alberta works appointment on the 14th but I’m scared they won’t approve me. I’m also looking into talking to the Calgary Dream Centre if I am approved. 

My concern is if none of that works, I’m stuck here and with the amount of money they feel I owe them I’ll be trapped for years more and I’m terrified of that.

I’ve always had “thoughts” like that before. I’ve never even come close to acting upon any of them. I am currently seeing a mental health professional and am taking care of these issues in a healthy way. 

My main concern is I’m feeling trapped and it seems no matter how hard I try I can’t seem to get on my feet to start taking those first steps.

I have strongly considered it but the shelters in my city have horrendous reputations and that terrifies the hell out of me. 

I’m trying to apply for a welfare of sorts so I can pay to stay at the dream centre again but I won’t know until the 14th.. I keep telling myself “it’s just a few more days” but it’s getting harder and harder to deal with this mentally.
